game.title.description: Name of the Yacht game card on the home screen.
game.title.notes: Do not translate the game name.

game.description.description: One-line description on the Yacht game card.

game.playLabel.description: Accessibility label for the Yacht play button.

round.header.description: Header showing current round out of 13.

section.upper.description: Header for the upper scoring section (Ones–Sixes).

section.lower.description: Header for the lower scoring section.

section.total.description: Label for the total score row.

category.threeOfAKind.description: Scoring category requiring three dice showing the same value.

category.fourOfAKind.description: Scoring category requiring four dice showing the same value.

category.fullHouse.description: Scoring category — three of one kind and two of another. Worth 25 points.
category.fullHouse.notes: The number (25) indicates the fixed point value — keep it.

category.smallStraight.description: Scoring category — four sequential dice. Worth 30 points.
category.smallStraight.notes: Write the full name; the row has room for it (two lines if needed). (30) / (40) is the point value.

category.largeStraight.description: Scoring category — five sequential dice. Worth 40 points.
category.largeStraight.notes: Write the full name; the row has room for it (two lines if needed). (30) / (40) is the point value.

category.yacht.description: Scoring category — five dice all the same. Worth 50 points.
category.yacht.notes: Do not translate 'Yacht!' — it is both the game name and the category name.

category.chance.description: Catch-all scoring category — sum of all dice.

score.scored.description: Accessibility text when a category is already scored.

score.potential.description: Accessibility text when a category can be scored this turn.

score.notAvailable.description: Accessibility text when a category cannot be scored this turn.

score.label.description: Accessibility label for a scoreable category cell, combining the category name and its current state.
score.label.notes: {{state}} is one of score.scored / score.potential / score.notAvailable.

score.you.description: Column header for the player's own score, shown in vs-mode scorecards.

score.opponent.description: Abbreviated column header for the opponent's score, shown in vs-mode scorecards.
score.opponent.notes: The AI opponent's column currently uses vsMode.cpu ('CPU'); this is the general opponent label.

score.empty.description: Placeholder shown in place of a score for a category that hasn't been scored yet.
score.empty.notes: An em dash — keep it short.

score.bonusLabel.description: Short label for the upper-section bonus row.

score.bonusRow.description: Label for the upper-section bonus subtotal row on the final scorecard.

score.bonusCountdown.description: Short-form countdown to the upper-section bonus, showing points still needed.
score.bonusCountdown.notes: {{n}} is the points still needed to reach the 63-point threshold; +35 is the fixed bonus value — keep both numbers.

score.total.description: Short label for the total-score row.

dice.label.description: Accessibility label for a die showing its index, value, and held state.
dice.label.notes: {{heldSuffix}} is either ', held' or empty string.

dice.labelBlank.description: Used when a die has no value yet (before first roll).

dice.heldSuffix.description: Appended to the die label when the die is held.

dice.hintAfterRoll.description: Hint text shown below dice after the first roll of a turn.

dice.hintBeforeRoll.description: Hint text shown below dice before any roll on a turn.

dice.holdHint.description: Accessibility hint for an unheld die.

dice.unholdHint.description: Accessibility hint for a held die.

roll.button.description: Roll button label showing remaining rolls.
roll.button.notes: {{count}} is 1, 2, or 3. Renders as e.g. 'Würfeln (2 übrig)'; the limit counts the raw {{count}}.

roll.label_one.description: Accessibility label for roll button — singular (1 roll left).

roll.label_other.description: Accessibility label for roll button — plural (2–3 rolls left).

bonus.yachtLabel.description: Label for the extra-Yacht bonus row, awarded for additional five-of-a-kind rolls after the first.
bonus.yachtLabel.notes: Yacht is the game/category name — keep it.

gameOver.upperBonus.description: Notice shown when the player earned the upper section bonus.
gameOver.upperBonus.notes: The +35 is a fixed game value — preserve it.

gameOver.yachtBonus.description: Result card subtitle announcing extra-Yacht bonuses scored during the game.
gameOver.yachtBonus.notes: 100 is the fixed per-bonus point value — keep the numbers and 'Yacht'.

difficulty.groupLabel.description: Accessibility label for the AI difficulty radio group.

vsMode.title.description: Title of the pre-game mode selector modal.

vsMode.solo.description: Button to start a single-player game with no AI opponent.

vsMode.vsComputer.description: Button / section label to play against the AI computer.

vsMode.yourTurn.description: Turn indicator shown when it is the human player's turn.

vsMode.computerTurn.description: Turn indicator shown when the AI is taking its turn.

gameOver.scorecard.description: Header above the full per-category breakdown shown in the result card's detail slot.

vsMode.vs.description: Short separator label between the two player scores in the VS score banner.
vsMode.vs.notes: Typically 'vs' — very short, often kept as-is across languages.

vsMode.rollCounter.description: Roll counter shown during a vs-mode turn, e.g. above the dice.
vsMode.rollCounter.notes: {{n}} is 1-3; 3 is the fixed number of rolls per turn — keep the number.

vsMode.category.description: Column header for the category-name column in the vs-mode scorecard.

vsMode.cpu.description: Column header and opponent label for the AI opponent in vs mode.
vsMode.cpu.notes: CPU is commonly kept as-is across languages.

vsMode.upperSubtotal.description: Row label for the upper-section subtotal in the vs-mode scorecard.

vsMode.lowerSubtotal.description: Row label for the lower-section subtotal in the vs-mode scorecard.

error.noRolls.description: Error banner text shown when a Yacht move is not allowed.

error.gameOver.description: Error banner text shown when a Yacht move is not allowed.

error.badHeld.description: Error banner text shown when a Yacht move is not allowed.

error.unknownCategory.description: Error banner text shown when a Yacht move is not allowed.

error.categoryScored.description: Error banner text shown when a Yacht move is not allowed.

error.rollFirst.description: Error banner text shown when a Yacht move is not allowed.

error.jokerUpper.description: Error banner text shown when a Yacht move is not allowed.
error.jokerUpper.notes: Joker rule messages explain Yacht's joker scoring rule.

error.jokerLower.description: Error banner text shown when a Yacht move is not allowed.
error.jokerLower.notes: Joker rule messages explain Yacht's joker scoring rule.

error.generic.description: Error banner text shown when a Yacht move is not allowed.

dice.hintRollToStart.description: Hint line under the dice before the first roll of a turn in a game against the computer, after the 'Your turn' label.

dice.hintComputer.description: Hint line under the dice while the computer takes its turn.

hint.hold.description: Message shown for 2 seconds when the hint button highlights the dice to keep.

hint.holdNone.description: Message shown for 2 seconds when the best move is to roll all five dice again.

hint.score.description: Message shown for 2 seconds when the hint button highlights the best scoring row.
hint.score.notes: {{category}} is a scoring category name, e.g. Full House (25).

hint.none.description: Short message shown for 2 seconds when there is no hint to give, e.g. before the first roll.

action.hint.description: Label on the hint button next to the roll button. Shown in capitals.

action.hintLabel.description: Accessibility label for the hint button: it highlights the best dice to keep or the best row for 2 seconds.

celebration.yacht.description: Big word shown over the board for a moment when the player rolls five of a kind.
celebration.yacht.notes: Keep the game name Yacht in Latin capitals in every language.

celebration.joker.description: Big word shown over the board for a moment when the player rolls a second five of a kind (a Joker).
celebration.joker.notes: Joker as in the card-game term for a wild card.

bonus.line.description: Second line of the upper subtotal band: points so far out of 63, and the +35 bonus they unlock.
bonus.line.notes: 63 is the fixed threshold, {{bonus}} is 35. Keep the numbers.

bonus.lineEarned.description: Same line once the 63-point threshold is reached and the bonus is earned. The check mark means earned.

gameOver.rowYou.description: Screen-reader label for one row of the final two-player scorecard when the player wins the row.

gameOver.rowCpu.description: Screen-reader label for one row of the final two-player scorecard when the computer wins the row.

gameOver.rowTie.description: Screen-reader label for one row of the final two-player scorecard when both score the same.

gameOver.yachtScored.description: Notice on the end-of-game card when the player scored a Yacht (five of a kind) in the Yacht row.

score.labelVs.description: Screen-reader label for one row of the scorecard in a game against the computer: the row, your state, then the computer's.
score.labelVs.notes: {{state}} is a phrase such as 'scored 22'; {{cpu}} is the computer's score or the 'not scored' phrase.

score.cpuOpen.description: What a screen reader says for the computer's value in a row it has not scored yet.
